how: The only luge track is the Yanqing National Sliding Centre about 74 km northwest of central Beijing (roughly 1 hour by the Jingzhang rail line plus transfer), beyond the 30 km metro radius and not open for casual use.
No glaciers exist in the Beijing region; the nearest trekkable glaciers are in the Tian Shan near Urumqi, roughly 2400 km away (about 4 hours by air plus transfer).
No ash-slope volcano suitable for boarding lies near Beijing; the nearest volcanic cones are around Datong (about 300 km, roughly 2 hours by high-speed rail).
Beijing is inland with no cetacean habitat; the nearest coast is Tianjin/Bohai Bay about 150 km away (roughly 1 hour by train) with no regular whale or dolphin tours.
Bullfighting is not part of Chinese culture and has no venues in the Beijing area; the nearest tradition is in Spain or Mexico, a 10+ hour flight away.
Recreational deer hunting is effectively prohibited under Chinese wildlife protection and firearm control law; the nearest game-hunting grounds are in Inner Mongolia, several hours away.
